verification.validation: Patch checks: basic gate (scripts/gate.sh: docs/version/manifest/timeout/internal-content checks, Go vet/build and core Go units, Python units, Node typecheck/units/build, frontend typecheck, 94 test files / 1221 unit tests (rerun on 0.53.6 after merging 0.53.5), build, packed consumer import and pack inventory), the browser checks in Chromium and WebKit with the portal phone fixture stacking DSM's header and body rows at z-index 1 (header hit-tested on top at rest, and per frame of the hide and show the header is on top and the App's content starts at its bottom), and the new portal cycles check (motion on, tab pages without a phone bar, a tab page with header actions and a sub-page: five touch drags down and up plus flings; no frame held over 200ms, the page answers, the content at the row's bottom on every frame, correct end states; it fails on 0.53.4 and on the first 0.53.5 commit), npm pack for both packages. Meeting Copilot (master a25d6cf) built with UI 0.23.7 RC and this SDK in a portal simulation: no freeze on Meetings scroll-up (the 0.53.4 reproduction passes), header on top with no band on Home, Meetings, Settings and a record page. Real DSM 7.3.2 (SA3200D) through the launchApp portal at 390x844 touch emulation: the z-index rule at rest, hidden and shown on Home, Meetings, Settings, a record page and Live; the final build (Meeting Copilot built with UI 0.23.7 RC and the 0.53.6 tarball) served in place of the installed bundle, five down/up cycles plus flings on Home, Meetings, Settings and a record page: every step answered with no long task over 100ms, Home and Meetings hid on every drag down and ended with the header on top and the content under it, Settings and the record page kept the App's bar in the header's place. No full gate, publication or real-device check.

changes: In DSM's Application Portal on a phone, DSM's header is stacked above the window body (z-index 2 over DSM's z-index 1 body row), so it is drawn over the App's room instead of under it: no empty band at the top of a phone page at rest, while hiding or while showing.

A phone page in DSM's Application Portal no longer freezes when the header comes back after a scroll (a 0.53.4 regression): DSM's account is read as DSM shows it while the SDK moves the header, the header gives way from the bar the page declares (title, actions, Back, page actions claiming the phone bar, or the account) rather than from the bar drawn at that moment, and the shell places the header at most once per frame and ignores its own writes.
After a flick the header returns at the UI's bar speed together with the App's content: the speed is read before the header's marks change.
The portal phone browser check reproduces DSM's row stacking and checks, at rest and per frame of the hide and show, that the header is on top and the App's content starts at its bottom.

A motion-on browser check drags tab pages (Home, Meetings), a page with actions and a sub-page down and up five times plus flings, and asserts no frame gap over 200ms, the App's content at the header's bottom on every frame, and the end states.
Reuse the immutable executor/v0.53.5 release and its six digests.
